    function initPlumb() {
      plumb = jsPlumb.getInstance({
        Container: canvasRef.value,
        Connector: ["Bezier", { curviness: 60 }],
        PaintStyle: { stroke: "#909399", strokeWidth: 2, outlineStroke: "transparent", outlineWidth: 4 },

    function removeConnection(conn) {

    function syncEndpoints() {
      nextTick(() => {
        if (!plumb) return;
        for (const n of nodes.value) {
          if (endpointDone.has(n.id)) continue;

            plumb.addEndpoint(el, {

            });

              if (node) {

    }
    function restoreConnections() {
      suppressConnectEvent = true;
      nextTick(() => {

    function genId(type) {

    function addNode(type, x, y) {

    function removeNode(id) {

    function onCanvasDrop(e) {

      if (!type) return;
      const rect = viewportRef.value?.getBoundingClientRect();
      if (!rect) return;

    }
    let panning = false;
    let panStartX = 0;
    let panStartY = 0;
    function onViewportMouseDown(e) {
      panning = true;
      panStartX = e.clientX - panX.value;
      panStartY = e.clientY - panY.value;
      const move = (ev) => {
        if (!panning) return;
        panX.value = ev.clientX - panStartX;
        panY.value = ev.clientY - panStartY;
      };
      const up = () => {
        panning = false;
        window.removeEventListener("mousemove", move);
        window.removeEventListener("mouseup", up);
      };
      window.addEventListener("mousemove", move);
      window.addEventListener("mouseup", up);
    }
    function setZoom(v) {

    }

    async function saveFlow(silent = false) {
      if (!flowName.value.trim()) {
        ElMessage.warning("\u8BF7\u8F93\u5165\u6D41\u7A0B\u540D\u79F0");
        return null;
      }
      if (!nodes.value.some((n) => n.type === "start")) {

        return null;
      }
      saving.value = true;
      try {
        const res = await api.saveFlow({
          Id: flowId.value || null,
          Name: flowName.value,
          Description: flowDesc.value,
          GraphJson: buildGraphJson()
        });
        flowId.value = res;
        if (!silent) ElMessage.success("\u4FDD\u5B58\u6210\u529F");
        return flowId.value;
      } catch {
        return null;
      } finally {
        saving.value = false;
      }
    }
    async function loadFlow(id) {
      try {
        const res = await api.getFlow(id);
        flowId.value = res.ID;
        flowName.value = res.Name;
        flowDesc.value = res.Description || "";
        const graph = JSON.parse(res.GraphJson || "{}");
        nodes.value = (graph.nodes || []).map((n) => ({
          id: n.id,
          type: n.type,
          name: n.name,
          x: n.x,
          y: n.y,
          config: n.configJson ? JSON.parse(n.configJson) : defaultConfig(n.type)
        }));
        edges.value = (graph.edges || []).map((e) => ({
          id: e.id,
          source: e.source,
          sourceHandle: e.sourceHandle || null,
          target: e.target
        }));
        const nums = nodes.value.map((n) => parseInt((n.id.match(/\d+/) || ["0"])[0], 10));
        nodeSeq = Math.max(0, ...nums);
        await nextTick();
        syncEndpoints();
        setTimeout(() => restoreConnections(), 50);
      } catch {
        ElMessage.error("\u52A0\u8F7D\u6D41\u7A0B\u5931\u8D25");
      }
    }
